description: Source code for static controller functions managing network routes and DNS modes, including enable/disable logic.

methods.name: static_enable
methods.description: Enables static routing and DNS configuration for IPv6 and IPv4, setting default routes and DNS modes.

methods.name: static_disable
methods.description: Disables static IPv6 routing by removing default routes; no action for IPv4.

methods.name: static_layer
methods.description: Main interface to enable or disable static network configuration based on the 'enable' flag.
